name: videodraft
description: AI video, image, audio and 3D asset generation plus the idea-to-MP4 storyboard/production pipeline, via the VideoDraft CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Generate AI videos, images, audio, 3D assets and storyboards
interface.longDescription: VideoDraft turns your agent into a video production studio. Generate standalone 3D assets, images, video clips, voiceovers, music, sound effects, dialogue, voice-changed and dubbed audio, or run the full idea to script to storyboard to timeline to exported MP4 pipeline. Uses the videodraft CLI for authenticated, cost-aware, async-batched generation and returns ready-to-use result URLs.
defaultPrompt: Generate a cinematic 16:9 image of a red fox in snow
Make a 6-second video of a slow dolly over a misty lake
Write a voiceover for this script and save the mp3
Turn this idea into a 30-second vertical ad
